tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. The site is light and editorial; never use pure white for the page.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, media frames, testimonial and form fields that sit on paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Bands that separate home sections, image placeholders, the footer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and icons on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk (13.7:1 or better) and on marker (11.8:1). Hairline drawings and architecture diagrams.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (5.7:1 or better). Never on marker below 16px.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules, card outlines, baseline grid. Not for controls; it carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: secondary button outline, tags, inputs (3:1 or better on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent. Fill of the primary action button with on-signal text, the active state of the object navigation, physics letters' accent tile. As text 4.6:1 on paper and 5.0:1 on paper-raised; on paper-sunk (4.1:1) only at 24px and up. Use signal-ink for small accent text.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text at any size on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (5.4:1 or better): metric numbers, inline emphasis, hover of the primary button.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (5.2:1).

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Links, the journey line on the About page, and the keyboard focus ring (6.3:1 on paper). Never decorative.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: A background fill, never text: the highlighter behind a few words in an intro or quote. The pair to check is ink on marker (11.8:1); marker against paper (1.3:1) is intentionally low, like a pen stroke. At most one highlight per screen.

tokens.name: marker-ink
tokens.usage: Yellow-family text on paper (4.8:1), paper-raised and paper-sunk, for when the marker colour itself must carry words. Never as a highlighter fill: ink on it is only 3.2:1.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The animated name in the home hero only. 56px below 640px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Case study and About page titles. 40px below 640px wide.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, project card titles, testimonial quotes (italic).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Case study sub-headings, the 20-word intro, button-sized statements.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drivers post trips, passengers book seats and pay through MobilePay.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines under 68 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions under media, footnotes, form hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, metadata, media labels, metric labels. Uppercase. Also the face of the text scramble.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag's text and its border, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags, between eyebrow and title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones, card inner padding on phones, gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter on desktop, gap between paragraphs and media.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between case study sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between home page sections; top padding of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and mono labels: almost square, like a stamp.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, media frames, screenshots, physics letter tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the object navigation's hover halo.

tokens.name: shadow-letter
tokens.usage: The material feel of the physics letters: a soft drop shadow that grows while a letter falls and tightens when it lands.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover state of project cards and navigation objects. Nothing else casts a shadow.
